semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Teesing provides critical infrastructure components and services for semiconductor manufacturing environments, particularly in gas and liquid handling systems.
summary: Teesing specializes in Ultra High Purity (UHP) gas and cooling water systems, offering components and fully assembled subsystems tailored to semiconductor manufacturing needs. They provide technical advice, prototype development, leak testing, and custom assembly, ensuring precision and reliability in gas and liquid handling systems.
capabilities: Custom assembly of gas and liquid systems
